histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.AttemptOtpFilling.GmailAndGoogleSmartFeaturesConsent
histogram.summary: Records the combination of the Gmail (comms_apps) and Google (google_apps) Smart Features consent states, with one bucket per combination. Recorded at most once per AttemptOtpFilling attempt, when the consent fetch succeeds. Not recorded when the tool is destroyed before the response or a mock OTP is used. Fetch failures are not recorded here; they are recorded as OneTimeTokens.Actor.AttemptOtpFilling.ToolInvocation bucket UnableToRetrieveGmailAndGoogleSmartFeaturesConsent.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.AttemptOtpFilling.GmailAndGoogleSmartFeaturesConsent.Duration.{Outcome}
histogram.summary: Time from requesting the Gmail and Google Smart Features consent states in AttemptOtpFilling Validate until the response ({Outcome}). Recorded once per consent fetch. Not recorded for mock OTP runs or if the tool is destroyed before the response.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.AttemptOtpFilling.GmailOtpConfirmationDialogInteraction
histogram.summary: Records the user's interaction with the Gmail OTP confirmation dialog during the AttemptOtpFilling tool execution: permission granted, permission denied, an error response, or Cancelled when the tool is destroyed after the dialog is requested and before a response is received (e.g. the task is stopped, paused or cancelled, or the tab is closed). Recorded once per dialog request. Nothing is recorded if the tool never requests the dialog.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.AttemptOtpFilling.GmailOtpOptInCardInteraction
histogram.summary: Records the user's interaction with the Gmail OTP opt-in card during the AttemptOtpFilling tool execution: permission granted, permission denied, an error response, or Cancelled when the tool is destroyed after the card is requested and before a response is received (e.g. the task is stopped, paused or cancelled, or the tab is closed). Recorded once per card request. Nothing is recorded if the tool never requests the card.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.AttemptOtpFilling.PredictedOtpType
histogram.summary: Records the OTP type predicted by the model when the AttemptOtpFilling action is invoked by the actor. This indicates whether the OTP is expected to be an SMS, Email, or from an Authenticator App. Recorded once per tool invocation.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.AttemptOtpFilling.ToolInvocation
histogram.summary: Records the terminal outcome of a single AttemptOtpFilling tool attempt by the actor: success, a specific failure (e.g. OTP retrieval, consent checks or filling), or the step during which the attempt was cancelled. This metric spans across the lifecycle methods Validate, TimeOfUseValidation and Invoke. The CancelledDuring* buckets are recorded when the tool is destroyed (e.g. the task is stopped, paused or cancelled, or the tab is closed) before the named asynchronous step completes. Recorded at most once per attempt.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.AttemptOtpFilling.ToolInvocation.{OptInState}
histogram.summary: Same as OneTimeTokens.Actor.AttemptOtpFilling.ToolInvocation, sliced by the Gmail OTP opt-in state for {OptInState}. Recorded alongside the base histogram, at most once per attempt. Not recorded when a mock OTP is used.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.AttemptOtpFilling.ValidateFormFillingContext.{Step}
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of the form filling context validation that the AttemptOtpFilling tool runs {Step}: Secure, or the first check that failed (e.g. no tab, an insecure page, a missing form or trigger field, a form that submits to an insecure action, OTP fields from different origins, or a frame that is missing or may not be filled). Recorded once per validation. Not recorded when the attempt ends before reaching this validation, e.g. when an earlier validation or the OTP retrieval fails.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.AttemptOtpFilling.VerifyIsActorLoginFlow
histogram.summary: Records whether the OTP frame matches a previous actor login flow. Recorded when matching outcomes (e.g. same origin without checker, exact or affiliated matches, allowed/disallowed PSL matches, or origin mismatches) are determined.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.OneTimeTokenFillingService.FillOtp
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of a single FillOtp request in ActorOneTimeTokenFillingService: a pre-fill error (e.g. a null tab, no trigger fields, a concurrent call, no autofill manager, a missing form or trigger field, or empty fill data), the renderer fill result (success or error), or Cancelled if the service is destroyed while the fill is pending (e.g. the actor task ends or the browser shuts down). Recorded once per request.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.OneTimeTokenFillingService.FillOtp.Duration.{Outcome}
histogram.summary: Time from triggering a single OTP fill until the ActorFillingObserver reported {Outcome}. Recorded once per fill that reaches the observer.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.OneTimeTokenFillingService.RetrieveOtp
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of a single OTP retrieval request in ActorOneTimeTokenFillingService: a null tab, no backend, a mock OTP, a cache or received match, a timeout, a sender-domain mismatch, a backend error, or Cancelled if the service is destroyed while the retrieval is pending (e.g. the actor task ends or the browser shuts down). Recorded once per request. Not recorded for a request that is superseded by a newer request. GmailOtpSenderDomainMismatch is recorded when the subscription timed out after at least one token delivered via the subscription was rejected for sender-domain mismatch. If the AttemptOtpFilling tool is destroyed while a retrieval is pending, the retrieval continues and its outcome is still recorded.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.OneTimeTokenFillingService.RetrieveOtp.Duration.{Outcome}
histogram.summary: Time from the start of a single OTP retrieval via GmailOtpRetriever until it ended with {Outcome}. Recorded once per request that reaches the retriever. Not recorded for requests that fail before the retriever starts (null tab, no backend, mock OTP) or that are superseded.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.OneTimeTokenFillingService.RetrieveOtp.{PredictedOtpType}
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of a single OTP retrieval request in ActorOneTimeTokenFillingService for a request where the model predicted the OTP to be {PredictedOtpType}. Uses the outcome buckets of OneTimeTokens.Actor.OneTimeTokenFillingService.RetrieveOtp and is recorded alongside it, once per request when the request ends.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Actor.OneTimeTokenFillingService.RetrieveOtpCallbackSuperseded
histogram.summary: Records events measuring how often a pending RetrieveOtp callback is superseded by a new RetrieveOtp request in ActorOneTimeTokenFillingService. Recorded at the start of RetrieveOtp invocations and when a pending callback is superseded.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Backend.Gmail.AuthLatency
histogram.summary: Records the duration of the OAuth token fetch for the Gmail OTP backend. Recorded when the access token fetch completes.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Backend.Gmail.ErrorCode
histogram.summary: Records the error encountered while attempting to retrieve Gmail one time tokens. Recorded when a retrieval attempt fails.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Backend.Gmail.ErrorLatency
histogram.summary: Real-time duration of the asynchronous attempt to retrieve a Gmail one time token from the backend. Recorded when the asynchronous job failed.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Backend.Gmail.HasActiveSubscription
histogram.summary: Records whether a subscription was already active when a Gmail OTP notification arrived. Recorded when an incoming Gmail OTP backend notification is received. True if a subscription was active (immediate hit), false if the notification had to wait for a subscription.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Backend.Gmail.NetworkLatency
histogram.summary: Records the duration of the network request to the OneTimeTokenService to fetch a Gmail one time token. Recorded when the response is received.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Backend.Gmail.QueueLatency
histogram.summary: Records the duration a Gmail OTP notification spent in the pending queue before being processed. Recorded when a notification is popped from the pending queue to be processed.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Backend.Gmail.QueueSize
histogram.summary: Recorded when a notification enters the coordinator; monitors the depth of the pending queue.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Backend.Gmail.SubscriptionWaitLatency
histogram.summary: Records the duration a Gmail OTP notification spent in the opportunistic cache waiting for a subscription, from when the notification is received to when it is retrieved from the cache. Recorded when a notification is retrieved from the opportunistic cache.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Backend.Gmail.Success
histogram.summary: Records whether the attempt to retrieve a Gmail one time token from the backend succeeds. Recorded when the asynchronous job has returned.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Backend.Gmail.SuccessLatency
histogram.summary: Real-time duration of the asynchronous attempt to retrieve a Gmail one time token from the backend. The latency is measured from when the incoming notification enters the pending queue to when the response from the Gmail backend is received. Recorded when the asynchronous job succeeded.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.EmailReceivedToTickleLatency
histogram.summary: Records the latency between an OTP email being received by the Gmail SMTP edge server and Chrome receiving the push notification (tickle) from the backend. Recorded upon tickle arrival.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.EmailSavedToTickleLatency
histogram.summary: Records the latency between an OTP email appearing in the user's inbox (stored in the mail store) and Chrome receiving the push notification (tickle) from the backend. Recorded upon tickle arrival.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.FieldDetectionToOtpSuggestionReadyLatency
histogram.summary: Records the latency between detecting an OTP field on a web page and the Gmail OTP suggestion becoming ready to be offered. Recorded once per origin listening session when the Gmail OTP push notification arrives after field detection.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.FieldDetectionToTickleLatency
histogram.summary: Records the latency between detecting an OTP field on a web page and receiving a push notification (tickle) from the backend. Recorded when a tickle arrives after an OTP field was detected.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.OptIn.BubbleResult
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of the Gmail OTP opt-in bubble. Recorded once when the opt-in bubble finishes its lifecycle (without being re-queued for reshow) or is discarded.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.OptIn.LearnMoreClicked
histogram.summary: Records a click on the Learn more link in the Gmail OTP opt-in bubble, which opens settings in a new tab. Only true is recorded. Recorded each time the link is clicked, so there can be several samples per bubble.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.OptIn.SettingsChange
histogram.summary: Records the outcome when the user toggles Gmail OTP filling on the chrome://settings contact info page, including turn-on attempts blocked by missing account consents or a failed consent fetch. Opt-ins from the opt-in bubble and the actor card are not recorded here.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.OptIn.State
histogram.summary: Records the user's Gmail OTP opt-in state when a tab sees both a Gmail tickle and an OTP field detection within 3 minutes of each other, in either order. Recorded in each such tab, so one tickle can be recorded more than once. If several states apply, records the first one in this order: bubble already showing, opted in, declined cool-off, session cool-off. Not decided means the opt-in bubble will be shown; OneTimeTokens.Gmail.OptIn.BubbleResult records its outcome.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.PageLanguage.{Outcome}
histogram.summary: Captures the page language distribution across different OTP outcomes and arrival sequences to identify locales with high win rates or missing backend push support. Recorded for {Outcome}.

variant.name: NoFieldDetected
variant.summary: tickles where no OTP field was detected within 3 minutes of arrival. The language is logged speculatively from the page open when the tickle was received.

variant.name: NoTickleReceived
variant.summary: OTP forms where no tickle was received within 3 minutes of field detection.

variant.name: TickleAfterUserInteraction
variant.summary: OTP forms where a tickle arrived after user interaction.

variant.name: TickleBeforeUserInteraction
variant.summary: OTP forms where a tickle arrived before user interaction.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.Tickle.Arrival
histogram.summary: Measures push notification delivery dynamics relative to form classification. Records the arrival order and timing of push notifications relative to OTP form detection on a web page.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.Tickle.FormOutcome
histogram.summary: Measures the outcome of every detected OTP form on a web page relative to push notification delivery and user interaction. Recorded either when a push notification arrives (before or after user interaction) or after 3 minutes have elapsed without receiving a push notification for this form.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.TickleToFieldDetectionLatency
histogram.summary: Records the latency between receiving a push notification (tickle) from the backend and detecting an OTP field on a web page. Recorded when an OTP field is detected on a page after a tickle was already received.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.Gmail.TickleTransmissionLatency
histogram.summary: Recorded upon tickle arrival to evaluate how long tickle travels from the server to the client, namely the diff between OneTimeTokenBackendNotification::notification_sent_timestamp and OneTimeTokenBackendNotification::notification_received_timestamp.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.{Type}.SenderDomainMatchAcceptedMatchType.{Source}
histogram.summary: Records the match type for an accepted sender domain match for {Source} OTP in {Type}. Recorded only when a token is accepted.

histogram.name: OneTimeTokens.{Type}.SenderDomainMatchRejectionReason.{Source}
histogram.summary: Records the reason why a sender domain match was rejected for {Source} OTP in {Type}. Recorded only when a token is rejected.
